title: Physics-Direct FPGA Tooth-Contact Computation for Deterministic Gear Digital Twins
abstract: arXiv:2609.04248v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Gear digital twins, hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and active vibration control close a loop around the instantaneous tooth-contact state, demanding a solver that is real-time, deterministic, and embeddable -- properties that loaded tooth contact analysis (LTCA), a data-dependent linear complementarity problem (LCP) costing seconds per mesh phase in fp64, structurally lacks; learned surrogates infer fast but spend one full LTCA solve per training sample and offer no guarantee beyond their training envelope. We instead compress the closed-form contact physics -- contact-point localization, principal-curvature extraction, and the elliptical Hertz solution -- directly into a branch-free fixed-point FPGA datapath, termed physics-direct, realized through the fully open-source openXC7 flow (no vendor tools, no floating-point IP) and validated on retired XC7K480T silicon. Four SoCs -- geometry, Hertz, and two fused paths -- pass bit-exact JTAG read

translated_title: 面向确定性齿轮数字孪生的物理直连FPGA齿面接触计算
translated_abstract: 齿轮数字孪生、硬件在环测试台以及主动振动控制需要围绕瞬时齿面接触状态构成闭环，这要求求解器具备实时性、确定性和可嵌入式特性——而承载齿面接触分析（LTCA）作为一种数据依赖的线性互补问题（LCP），在fp64精度下每个啮合阶段需要耗费数秒，在结构上缺乏上述特性；学习型代理模型推理速度快，但每个训练样本都需要一次完整的LTCA求解，且无法保证其在训练范围之外的表现。我们转而将闭式接触物理——接触点定位、主曲率提取以及椭圆赫兹解——直接压缩到无分支的定点FPGA数据通路中，称为“物理直连”方法，通过完全开源的openXC7流程实现（无需供应商工具、无需浮点IP），并在退役的XC7K480T芯片上进行了验证。四个SoC——几何、赫兹以及两条融合路径——通过了位级精确的JTAG读取验证。
tldr: 本文提出“物理直连”方法，将闭式齿面接触物理（接触点定位、主曲率提取、椭圆赫兹解）直接编译为无分支定点FPGA数据通路，借助全开源openXC7流程实现确定性、实时的齿轮接触计算，避免了传统LTCA数秒级的求解耗时以及学习型代理模型的训练开销与训练范围外失效的风险。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a "physics-direct" approach that compiles closed-form tooth-contact physics (contact-point localization, principal-curvature extraction, and the elliptical Hertz solution) directly into a branch-free fixed-point FPGA datapath via the fully open-source openXC7 flow, achieving deterministic real-time gear contact computation while avoiding the seconds-long LTCA solve times and the training cost and out-of-distribution risks of learned surrogates.
